name: UK VAT Classification
description: Classifies products into UK VAT liability categories and infers intended use. Code looks up the rate from the returned category.

vat_category.instructions: Classify the product described in `product` into the correct UK VAT category. Apply HMRC VAT liability rules.

standard_rated.what: Standard-rated at 20% — default for goods/services not in another category
examples: hot food sold for immediate consumption

reduced_energy.what: Reduced-rated at 5% — domestic fuel and power

reduced_health_welfare.what: Reduced-rated at 5% — specific HMRC-listed health and welfare goods

zero_food.what: Zero-rated at 0% — basic food and drink for human consumption, sold for home preparation
zero_food.not_for: Hot food, catering, alcohol, confectionery, crisps, ice cream, sports drinks, products with a chocolate coating

zero_children_clothing.what: Zero-rated at 0% — clothing and footwear designed for children up to age 14 in recognised small sizes
zero_children_clothing.not_for: Adult sizes even if bought for a child
examples: children's school uniform in small sizes
school shoes in a child's size

zero_books_print.what: Zero-rated at 0% — books, newspapers, magazines, maps, music scores, and their digital equivalents
zero_books_print.not_for: Stationery, diaries without substantial printed content

zero_passenger_transport.what: Zero-rated at 0% — public passenger transport in vehicles carrying 10 or more passengers
zero_passenger_transport.not_for: Taxis, private hire, vehicle rental, freight

zero_pharmaceuticals.what: Zero-rated at 0% — prescription medicines dispensed by a registered pharmacist; certain medical equipment for disabled persons

exempt_financial.what: Exempt — financial, insurance, and investment services; no VAT charged and no input VAT recovery

exempt_education.what: Exempt — education by an eligible body or private tuition in a school subject by an individual
exempt_education.not_for: Commercial training courses from VAT-registered businesses
examples: private maths tutoring by an individual

exempt_medical_services.what: Exempt — healthcare services by a registered medical professional in their professional capacity

outside_scope.what: Outside the scope of UK VAT — not a supply of goods or services in the course of a business

intended_use.instructions: Based only on `product.name` and `product.description`, infer the product's most likely intended use. Do not rely on any explicitly stated intended use — infer it from the product itself.

criteria.retail_home_consumption: Sold through retail for use or consumption at home by end consumers
criteria.catering_food_service: Supplied as part of a catering or food service operation — to restaurants, cafes, canteens, or for on-site consumption
criteria.children_specific: Product designed, sized, or marketed specifically for use by children
criteria.domestic_residential: Installed or used in a domestic or residential property — e.g. home energy, renovation materials
criteria.commercial_industrial: Used in a commercial, manufacturing, or industrial operation
criteria.medical_healthcare: Supplied or used in a medical, dental, or healthcare setting, or prescribed by a medical professional
criteria.education_training: Used in formal education or training
criteria.financial_insurance: A financial, insurance, or investment product or service
criteria.passenger_transport: A passenger transport service for the general public
criteria.general_consumer: A general consumer product not clearly fitting another category
